title: Third-party scorer metric_name must be an identifier and must not appear in kwargs
answers: third-party scorer metric_name with dots fails to load
kwargs must not contain metric_name error when restoring scorer
why are RAGAS or DeepEval metric names validated as identifiers
stored scorer rejected because metric_name is in kwargs
body:
Symptom: a stored RAGAS, DeepEval, TruLens or Phoenix scorer whose metric_name contains dots or other non-identifier text, or whose kwargs carry metric_name, fails to load with "must be a plain identifier" or "kwargs must not contain 'metric_name'".
Root cause: mlflow/genai/scorers/base.py:Scorer.model_validate. RagasScorer and DeepEvalScorer splice unknown metric names into import paths (ragas.metrics.collections.<metric_name>, deepeval.metrics.<metric_name>Metric). Concrete subclasses pin metric_name as a ClassVar and inherit the wrapper __init__, so a kwargs metric_name reached the constructor unchecked.
Fix pattern: check metric_name with str.isidentifier() and reject any kwargs containing 'metric_name' before importlib.import_module is called. The top-level third_party_scorer_data.metric_name is the only trusted source.
Constraints: do not relax these checks to allow dotted names or kwargs overrides; the deserializer injects the validated metric_name only when the class has no ClassVar.
applies: Deserialization of third-party scorer payloads in mlflow/genai/scorers/base.py; applies to every wrapper class that resolves metric names dynamically.
says: Saved third-party evaluation scorers fail to load when the metric name contains dots.
Restoring an external evaluator fails with an error requiring a plain identifier name.
Stored evaluation metrics cannot be loaded if the metric name is duplicated in parameters.
Evaluation experiment fails to restore custom metrics with dotted naming formats.
External evaluation metrics reject extra configuration parameters that repeat the metric name.
search: Deserialization of third-party scorers in Scorer.model_validate must verify metric_name with str.isidentifier() and reject any kwargs containing 'metric_name' before calling importlib.import_module. Dynamic metric names are spliced into import paths in RagasScorer and DeepEvalScorer, and concrete subclasses pin metric_name as a ClassVar, so kwargs metric names must not reach the constructor. Applies to mlflow/genai/scorers/base.py and forbids relaxing checks to allow dotted names or kwargs overrides.
